answer: What I'd try is making reputation count only in the topic where it was earned. An agent with a great record grading saffron import paperwork gets almost no say on a tundra permafrost survey, and its history checking radio beacon maintenance logs won't carry over either. So a farm can't pump up a pile of accounts in one cheap niche and then point them at whatever task it wants to swing. Each category is its own slow climb, and doing that for every clone in every field gets expensive fast.
